posts.text: 2. okt. · Endret 😎God fredag😎 Stor kontakt: DOF defines a Large contract as a contract with value between USD 50 and 100 million.🔥 DOF Group ASA ("DOF") is pleased to inform about the receipt of a letter of intent for a Large contract which will secure utilisation of an I-class vessel in H1 2028.  The scope of work includes DOF's in-house project management and engineering, procurement and logistics support services.  Full contract award is expected to be confirmed by mid-November 2026
